$comment: Schema and examples for all sprint log JSON files under docs/sprint-logs/{SprintID}/

decisions.$comment: Autonomous decisions made during the sprint

verification_results.$comment: Combined test execution + AC traceability. Replaces the older split between e2e-results.json and acceptance-matrix.json. Each test entry carries its linked story/AC so traceability is derivable from this single file.

tests.name: [AC-Sb1e4d8-1-1] should display VM list after login
[AC-Sb1e4d8-1-2] should start VM and show running status

diff_coverage.$comment: Rule 6 — user-observable additions in this Sprint's diff and how each is covered. Resolution is one of: covered (test exists), added_test (new test added during verify), reverted (out-of-scope, removed), needs_human (escalated).

surfaces.test: [AC-Sb1e4d8-1-1] should display VM list after login

refine.$comment: Interactive refinement changes from user feedback

attempts.result: Production LDAP has custom schema not replicable

scenario.$comment: User scenario for a non-GUI Story (CLI, API, library). GUI Stories use gui-spec-{StoryID}.json instead. See sprint/references/story-scenarios.md for the full taxonomy and rules.
scenario.user_role: operator running deploys from their laptop

scenarios.description: Operator starts a stopped VM and confirms it is running
preconditions: A VM named vm-123 exists in stopped state

gui_spec.$comment: GUI specification for a Story — state diagram + endpoint contracts
gui_spec.state_diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Empty: page load (no data)
    Empty --> Loading: user clicks Add
    Loading --> Populated: API success
    Loading --> Error: API failure

scenarios.happy_path: User sees VM list, clicks Start, VM status changes to running

data_states.empty: Show empty state message with Create button
data_states.error: Show error message with Retry button

edge_cases: Long VM names truncated with ellipsis
scenarios.success_feedback: Inline status update with brief toast
scenarios.failure_feedback: Error message below the action button
